title: Item threads and Plan comments update live and show what is unread

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: only messages and room_messages are in the realtime publication, so a Plan comment appears only after a reload, and nothing tracks what a person has read. Fix: a thread_reads row per person per thread (last read message), and new thread messages broadcast from the database (realtime.broadcast_changes on private channels, Supabase's recommended pattern over Postgres Changes). About 0.3M realtime messages a month at 100 collaborators, inside the Pro quota.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
